name: LangGraph
summary: A low-level orchestration framework from LangChain for building stateful, long-running agents as graphs of nodes and edges. It provides durable execution, human-in-the-loop interrupts and short- and long-term memory, and can be used with or without LangChain. LangSmith adds tracing, evals and a managed deployment platform.
goodFor: Explicit control flow with branches and cycles
watchOut: Low-level: more code than prebuilt agent loops
Best tooling (Studio, Deployment) sits in paid LangSmith
